record.question: Fill in the blanks: (a) The retiring Govt. servant should formally relinquish charge of office on the afternoon of that day itself even if it happens to be a ______________. (b) A Govt. servant whose date of birth is first of a month shall retire on the afternoon of the last day of the ______________ month on attaining the age of sixty years. (c) While a Govt. servant is in ______________ service on deputation, contributions towards the cost of his pension and leave salary must be paid to general revenues on his behalf. (d) Central Civil Service (Joining Time) Rules came into force w.e.f ______________. (e) No joining time is admissible in cases of temporary transfer. Only actual ______________ may be allowed.
